winddown_quotes.quote: One thing worth your call when you're rested: 30 is hardcoded in and not exported.

Two things I'd want you to confirm when you're rested, both consequences of "unreadable is false" rather than bugs in it: a garbled range silently reports *no* clash, so if ever guards a double-boo...
